## #14 Code copy + language label
- **ACs:** 13/13 covered by 8 unit tests and 20 e2e tests, all PASS. Rule 13 (#19 export) can't be checked yet: #19 is not built.
- **QA:** PASS, no defects. Not checkable: split-view typing, because #7 is not in this lane.
- **Review:** PASS, no blockers.
- **Fixes:**
  - A mouseup is swallowed only when the press started on the toolbar, so a drag-select that ends over the toolbar still raises the comment bar. There is a test for it.
  - `copyText` always removes its textarea and returns focus.
  - GitHub-mode 16px alignment.
  - `data-export-strip` on the toolbar and the live region.
  - A comment about plugin order.
  - DECISIONS lines: text-secondary vs text-muted, and the popover staying open.
- **Lane-gate fix:** the `<pre>` stays the code box, because #1's frozen tests pin its background, border and radius. The toolbar is absolutely positioned over a strip the `<pre>` reserves with top padding, and has no z-index (it was covering the selection action bar).

## #16 Callouts + RAG badges
- **ACs:** 14/14 covered by 21 unit tests and 12 e2e tests, all PASS.
- **QA:** PASS. It found 1 minor and 2 cosmetic issues; all fixed:
  - A long label scrolled the phone page sideways. Now ellipsis plus `title`.
  - Bold text in a title showed in body colour. Now inherits the title colour.
  - Locus warning and caution were both orange. Caution now uses the Locus status red.
- **Review:** PASS. All 2 should-fix and 5 nits fixed:
  - Dark themes now print legible RAG pills and Locus titles.
  - Block title (spaces around inline markup) recorded in DECISIONS.
  - Print colours scoped away from GitHub themes.
  - RAG labels unescape backslashes only; entities stay as typed.
  - No word boundary, recorded in DECISIONS.
  - Important uses `var(--accent)`.
- The MCP `create_session` descriptions in both servers now name both syntaxes.

## #17 Collapsible sections
- **ACs:** 14/14 covered by 10 unit tests and 25 e2e tests, all PASS. This includes rule 14 (scroll-to-comment) and the `beforematch` path.
- **QA:** PASS. Its findings, all fixed:
  - **minor:** Edit → Read with `#frag` in the URL undid folds. The load-time reveal now runs once per doc visit.
  - **minor:** tablet/phone headings indented by the inline toggle. Recorded in DECISIONS; tablet now uses the inline mode too.
  - **cosmetic:** tap highlight.
- **Review:** PASS. All 3 should-fix and 6 nits fixed:
  - The tablet gutter clipped the toggle.
  - The initial reveal now retries until its target exists.
  - Folded `<hr>` blocks and margins take no space.
  - The print `display` override no longer applies to tables.
  - The ellipsis glyph moved to CSS.
  - Fold controls use `data-preview-control`, which PreviewPane's comment flow ignores, instead of stopping propagation.
  - Folds carry over when a local doc is shared.
  - The TOC buttons are a `v-for`.
  - New tests: duplicate ids, a mermaid diagram inside a fold, an H5-only doc.
- I also found and fixed this myself: the fold key settles after the render (a restored draft shows the slug before the GET names the id), so folds are re-keyed then.

## #15 Zoom / pan viewer
- **ACs:** 15/15 covered by 6 unit tests and 22 e2e tests, all PASS.
- **QA:** FAIL → fixed. Both defects are fixed and covered by a regression test:
  - **D1, major:** after a stage press, focus dropped to `<body>`, so Esc and +/− stopped working.
  - **D2, minor:** focus was lost when a zoom button disabled at min/max.
- **Review:** FAIL, with the same blocker → fixed:
  - Keys are now handled by a document capture listener while the viewer is open.
  - The dialog root is focusable, and a stage press keeps focus inside.
  - All 3 should-fix and 4 nits fixed:
    - The trigger ignores repeat and modifier chords.
    - A live region inside the dialog announces "Copied".
    - Focus returns to the same-index trigger after a re-render.
    - The tap timer is cleared.
    - Image load listeners are de-duplicated.
    - `zoom-level` no longer announces every wheel tick.
    - Bold Locus pie labels in the viewer clone.
- I also found and fixed these myself:
  - Pointer capture retargets the click, so a click on the content closed the viewer. Background-click detection now uses where the press landed.
  - Copy source dropped its trailing newline.
  - Touch sticky hover.
- One test fix: AC-15.3 now ends its drag inside the visible part of a tall diagram, so the mouseup lands in the pane.
